name: cerebro-agent-receipts
description: Capture signed local evidence for Codex tool executions and compare it with provider audit events.

interface.shortDescription: Find agent actions and provider changes that lack attribution.
interface.longDescription: Cerebro Agent Receipts records chained local execution evidence from Codex hooks, reduces hook phases into actions, and reports provider activity without a one-to-one action match.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show provider-observed changes that do not have a one-to-one agent action match.
